about.title: About Stick It to the Stickman Wiki
paragraphs: Stick It to the Stickman Wiki is an independent, fan-made reference hub for Stick It to the Stickman, the rogue-lite physics brawler developed by Free Lives and published by Devolver Digital.
In the game you fight your way through a hostile workplace: chain combat moves, grab weapons and superpowers, unlock new workers and game modes, and climb the corporate ladder toward becoming CEO.

Our guides are built from official sources — the Steam store page, the official game website, and Devolver Digital — with an independent editorial voice. We are not affiliated with or endorsed by Free Lives, Devolver Digital, or Valve.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: Stick It to the Stickman Wiki (stickittothestickmanwiki.space) is an independent, fan-made information site about the video game Stick It to the Stickman. We are not affiliated with the game's developer Free Lives or its publisher Devolver Digital.
